title: Add first-class tag support
description: Tags are a CSV `tags` metadata field on every backend (file + git). Custom meads.Tags []string type transcodes the CSV form; tags validate as ^[a-z0-9-]+$. CLI: md add --tags, md update --tags/--add-tags/--rm-tags, md list --tag, md ready --tag. Also wired through MCP/webui inputs and the prime docs.
